title: 2008 HMMT February Team Round 2 Problem 7
statement: Determine the number of juggling sequences of length \(n\) with exactly 1 ball.

solutions.text: \(2^{n}-1\). Solution: With 1 ball, we simply need to decide at times should the ball land in our hand. That is, we need to choose a non-empty subset of \(\{0,1,2, \ldots, n-1\}\) where the ball lands. It follows that the answer is \(2^{n}-1\).
